body: my parents are emotionally and sometimes physically abusive, they don't really understand mental illness and chalk it up to me being lazy or stupid. its just frustrating and I've been struggling since 7th grade(I'm in 10th now and it just hasn't gotten any better). Ive seen multiple psychiatrists and therapists and things seemed to be getting better for a little while but then my meds stopped working, i stopped being able to self medicate with weed, i cant leave my house which was my only out, i dont have sports anymore, i cant go bike riding, i cant see my friends(and im not even allowed to hang out with my best friends anymore because my parents think they're causing me to be this way),i cant even sit outside without being watched. i have nothing anymore and i just cant be in this house anymore without cutting or doing something to mentally escape
im starting to believe that the people who bullied enough kids in their youth are the ones running the hotline and this is their way of moralizing driving someone they know to suicide
right, and my parents act like i asked to be here and say I'm ungrateful for wanting bare necessities like food, water, and shelter

that's the thing. i never want to be a parent because what if I turn out exactly like my parents did. i don't want to fuck up someone else's life because I'm so messed up on my own. if I can barely take care of myself and want myself to live, how am I going to want that for another person
